The furniture features light-colored wood construction with multiple sections: tall vertical cabinets with glass doors on the upper halves and solid panel doors on the lower halves. The shelves are densely packed with books of various sizes and colors. There is a black electronic device (possibly a printer or stereo component) on a counter to the left. The perspective is slightly wide-angle, showing the depth of the room.

The paneling on the lower central cabinet doors appears warped and inconsistent. The vertical lines of the door frames do not align perfectly, and the 'knobs' seem to float or lack proper attachment geometry. One door panel seems to have a strange indentation or melting effect near the bottom.
